caption: The drawing shows two identical rectangular objects with rounded edges, placed side by side horizontally in the center of the image on a plain beige background. Each object has a black outline and is decorated with small, circular yellow dots evenly spaced around the perimeter. Inside each rectangle, there is a black, arch-like structure at the top, with a vertical black bar down the middle and a horizontal black bar across the lower third of the rectangle, connected to the sides. The decorations are rendered in a minimalistic and schematic style, with the drawn elements contained within a small white rectangle positioned in the middle of the beige page.
title: Woman's Buckles
